content.short: Cross-border business account and treasury platform for SMEs/e-commerce.
content.description: WorldFirst is a cross-border business payments platform, now part of Ant Group, that helps SMEs and e-commerce sellers collect, hold, convert, and send money across global markets. Through its World Account, businesses get local receiving accounts in many currencies, competitive foreign exchange, supplier payments, and tools tailored to online sellers on marketplaces like Amazon, eBay, and others. Popular with importers, exporters, and cross-border merchants especially across Asia and internationally, WorldFirst focuses on making it easy to get paid by overseas platforms and pay suppliers abroad without maintaining multiple foreign bank accounts. By combining multi-currency accounts, FX, and marketplace-friendly payment features, WorldFirst positions itself as a practical treasury and payments platform for globally trading small and medium businesses.
content.meta: WorldFirst offers cross-border business accounts and FX for SMEs and e-commerce. Discover WorldFirst and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
